'''2001 Candace Hall Memorial Charles Hickey Candace Hall Winner''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Charles Hickey]] posted on DeckTech after finishing 1st at [[2001 Candace Hall Memorial]].<ref name="dt-16075">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/16075 Candace Hall Winner], DeckTech (Charles "Teacher" Hickey, 20 May 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/16075/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/16075/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Charles Hickey]]
* '''Event:''' [[2001 Candace Hall Memorial]]
* '''Finish:''' 1st
* '''Published:''' 20 May 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Candace Hall Winner''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif|label=Watch Your Step}}

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 WYS Hickey LS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' This is a very solid WYS deck.   Makes use of some interesting card choices.

== Original post ==

'''Candace Hall Winner'''
* '''Author:''' Charles "Teacher" Hickey
* '''Published:''' May 20, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 4.5
* '''Description:''' This is a very solid WYS deck.   Makes use of some interesting card choices.

=== Strategy ===

This deck won me the Candace Hall Memorial Event at Broken Games, with a combined score of 4(+51)

It was a 4 game event.
